results.name: two rectangles: all four shape modes equal GEOS exactly; paint + stacking follow Illustrator (front paint; Minus Front keeps the back)
rotated rectangle (transform) × ellipse: every mode within flattening tolerance of GEOS (IoU ≥ 0.9995)
three operands: Minus Front subtracts every front shape from the back one; Exclude fills odd coverage only (GEOS XOR chain)
fill rules: even-odd hole, nonzero opposite-direction hole, nonzero same-direction (no hole), group = union of leaves with its transform
refusals: open paths, text, a single shape, locked shapes, Intersect of disjoint shapes; result survives SVG export → import
performance: two 600-unit ellipses + a rotated rect, all modes < 400 ms each on this 2-CPU host
